records.jp: よし、これをセットして……
records.en_original: All right, we'll just put these here...
records.en_auxiliary: All right, we'll just put these here...
records.en: All right, we'll just put these here...

records.jp: じゃあみんな、配置につこう！
records.en_original: Okay, everyone! Time to set things up!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, everyone! Time to set things up!
records.en: Okay, everyone! Time to set things up!

records.jp: みんなの方はどう？
records.en_original: What's the status in your area?
records.en_auxiliary: What's the status in your area?
records.en: What's the status in your area?

records.jp: こちらチームB、配置につきました――<CR>ねえ、本当にこれやんないとダメ？
records.en_original: Team B, reporting in. The trap has been set. ...Do I really have to talk like this?
records.en_auxiliary: Team B, reporting in. The trap has been set. ...Do I really have to talk like this?
records.en: Team B is in position—<CR>Do we really have to do this?

records.jp: ダメだよ、こういうのは形から入らないと！
records.en_original: Yes! We've gotta act the part!
records.en_auxiliary: Yes! We've gotta act the part!
records.en: Yes. You have to get into character for things like this!

records.jp: はあ……まあいいけど
records.en_original: Hmph. Whatever you say.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmph. Whatever you say.
records.en: Hmph. Whatever you say.

records.jp: ふふっ。星崎さん、ノリノリですね
records.en_original: Hehe. She's certainly excited, isn't she?
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. She's certainly excited, isn't she?
records.en: Hehe. Hoshizaki-san is really enjoying this.

records.jp: なんだろう、<CR>こういう変なことが好きなんだよね、星崎さんって……
records.en_original: Hoshizaki does seem to be a fan of strange things like this...
records.en_auxiliary: Hoshizaki does seem to be a fan of strange things like this...
records.en: I don't know...<CR>Hoshizaki-san really likes weird stuff like this...

records.jp: こちらチームC～！　異常ありませ～ん！
records.en_original: Team C, coming in! Everything's lookin' good!
records.en_auxiliary: Team C, coming in! Everything's lookin' good!
records.en: Team C, coming in! Everything's lookin' good!

records.jp: 本当にこれでユズちゃんと会えるのかな？
records.en_original: Will we really find Yuzu this way?
records.en_auxiliary: Will we really find Yuzu this way?
records.en: Will this really let us find Yuzu-chan?

records.jp: まあ、なるようになるでしょ。それに――
records.en_original: Y'know, whatever happens, happens. Besides—
records.en_auxiliary: Y'know, whatever happens, happens. Besides—
records.en: Whatever happens, happens. Besides—

records.jp: あたし、一個心当たりがあるんだ
records.en_original: I think I have an idea that should work.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I have an idea that should work.
records.en: I have one idea.

records.jp: あっ――
records.en_original: Ah—
records.en_auxiliary: Ah—
records.en: Ah—

records.jp: 待って、日菜子さん！　慎重に行こ……
records.en_original: Wait, Hinako! Be patient...
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, Hinako! Be patient...
records.en: Wait, Hinako-san! Let's be careful...

records.jp: ターゲット確認！　作業室へと入っていきました！
records.en_original: Target confirmed! She's headed toward the work room!
records.en_auxiliary: Target confirmed! She's headed toward the work room!
records.en: Target spotted! She entered the workroom!

records.jp: 逃げ道を塞ぎつつ……突入します！
records.en_original: We've gotta make sure she doesn't have anywhere to run. Entering now!
records.en_auxiliary: We've gotta make sure she doesn't have anywhere to run. Entering now!
records.en: Blocking the escape route... Moving in!

records.jp: 確保ー！！
records.en_original: Target secured!
records.en_auxiliary: Target secured!
records.en: Got you!!

records.jp: ユズっ！
records.en_original: Yuzu!
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu!
records.en: Yuzu!

records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.jp: ユズ……ようやく、会えた……
records.en_original: Yuzu... I finally get to see you again...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu... I finally get to see you again...
records.en: Yuzu... I finally found you...

records.jp: あなた――
records.en_original: You—
records.en_auxiliary: You—
records.en: You—

records.jp: なんで、私の名前を…………？
records.en_original: How do you know my name?
records.en_auxiliary: How do you know my name?
records.en: How do you know my name?

records.jp: えっ……
records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: まさか、ユズさんも記憶喪失なの！？
records.en_original: No way. Yuzu's got amnesia too?!
records.en_auxiliary: No way. Yuzu's got amnesia too?!
records.en: No way. Did Yuzu-san lose her memory too?!

records.jp: 例外はないってことか……
records.en_original: Seems there are no exceptions to the rule...
records.en_auxiliary: Seems there are no exceptions to the rule...
records.en: So there really are no exceptions...

records.jp: …………今は、落ち込んでる場合じゃない
records.en_original: This isn't the time to lose hope.
records.en_auxiliary: This isn't the time to lose hope.
records.en: ...This is no time to be discouraged.

records.jp: ユズ、あなたに伝えなきゃいけないことがある
records.en_original: Yuzu, I have something I need to tell you.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu, I have something I need to tell you.
records.en: Yuzu, I have something I need to tell you.

records.jp: ライムを、助けに来た
records.en_original: We're here to save Lime.
records.en_auxiliary: We're here to save Lime.
records.en: I came to save Lime.

records.jp: ライムの名前まで……。ってことはまさか、<CR>私たちと関わりのある人物なの……？
records.en_original: You know her name...? Do you have some kind of connection to us?
records.en_auxiliary: You know her name...? Do you have some kind of connection to us?
records.en: You even know Lime...<CR>Could you be someone connected to us?

records.jp: あなたたち二人に直接言われたの。<CR>私の心の世界……ココロトープで
records.en_original: You told me to say that. We met in my Heartscape, the world of my emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: You told me to say that. We met in my Heartscape, the world of my emotions.
records.en: The two of you told me directly.<CR>In the world of my heart—my Heartscape.

records.jp: ライムを助けに来た。そう伝えてほしいって
records.en_original: You said to tell you that we want to save Lime.
records.en_auxiliary: You said to tell you that we want to save Lime.
records.en: You asked me to tell you: "I have come to save Lime."

records.jp: ……記憶を失う前の私がメッセージを残したんだ
records.en_original: A message from before losing my memory...
records.en_auxiliary: A message from before losing my memory...
records.en: ...Myself before losing my memory left a message.

records.jp: ライムのことまで知っている以上、<CR>信用しないわけにはいかない……
records.en_original: If you know Lime, then I should be able to trust you...
records.en_auxiliary: If you know Lime, then I should be able to trust you...
records.en: Since you even know about Lime,<CR>I have no choice but to trust you...

records.jp: あなた、名前は？
records.en_original: What is your name?
records.en_auxiliary: What is your name?
records.en: What is your name?

records.jp: 白井、日菜子
records.en_original: Hinako Shirai.
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako Shirai.
records.en: Shirai Hinako.

records.jp: 日菜子……
records.en_original: Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako...
records.en: Hinako...

records.jp: ありがとう、日菜子。そして――
records.en_original: Thank you, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Hinako.
records.en: Thank you, Hinako.

records.jp: 星崎愛央。あなたのことはまだ、<CR>何も分からないけど……一旦保留にする
records.en_original: I may not trust you yet, Ao Hoshizaki, but I'll put my reservations aside for now.
records.en_auxiliary: I may not trust you yet, Ao Hoshizaki, but I'll put my reservations aside for now.
records.en: Hoshizaki Ao. I still know<CR>nothing about you...but I will set that aside for now.

records.jp: 私が知っていることを話す必要がある。<CR>みんな、今から――
records.en_original: I'll tell you everything I know. Everyone, I—
records.en_auxiliary: I'll tell you everything I know. Everyone, I—
records.en: I need to tell you what I know.<CR>Everyone, now—

records.jp: ちょっと待って
records.en_original: Hold on a sec.
records.en_auxiliary: Hold on a sec.
records.en: Hold on a sec.

records.en_original: Y-yes?
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yes?
records.en: Y-yes?

records.jp: あたしからも一つ、確認しなきゃいけないことがある
records.en_original: I just wanna check one thing.
records.en_auxiliary: I just wanna check one thing.
records.en: I just wanna check one thing.

records.jp: あたしたちの食料、<CR>つまみ食いしてたのってユズでしょ！！
records.en_original: You're the one that's been eating our food, aren't you!
records.en_auxiliary: You're the one that's been eating our food, aren't you!
records.en: Yuzu was the one<CR>snacking on our food, right?!

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: だから、あたしたちの食料！<CR>最近やけに減りが早いと思ったんだよ！
records.en_original: Our food! We've been going through way more than usual lately!
records.en_auxiliary: Our food! We've been going through way more than usual lately!
records.en: Our food!<CR>I knew it had been disappearing unusually fast!

records.jp: さっき言ってたの、これかぁ……
records.en_original: So this is what you were talking about before...
records.en_auxiliary: So this is what you were talking about before...
records.en: So this is what you meant earlier...

records.jp: それ、今する話……？
records.en_original: Is this really something to talk about now?
records.en_auxiliary: Is this really something to talk about now?
records.en: Is this really something to talk about now?

records.jp: 大切でしょ！　食べ物は！
records.en_original: This is important! Food is important!
records.en_auxiliary: This is important! Food is important!
records.en: Food is important!

records.jp: そ、それは……美味しそうだったから、つい
records.en_original: I-it just looked so good... I couldn't help myself.
records.en_auxiliary: I-it just looked so good... I couldn't help myself.
records.en: I-it just looked so good... I couldn't help myself.

records.jp: 働かざる者！！
records.en_original: Those who don't work...
records.en_auxiliary: Those who don't work...
records.en: Those who do not work!!

records.jp: 食う、べからず――
records.en_original: Don't eat.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't eat.
records.en: Do not eat—

records.jp: ご、ごめんなさい……
records.en_original: I-I'm sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I'm sorry...
records.en: I-I'm sorry...

records.jp: まあまあ、いろいろ教えてくれるっていうし、<CR>それが代金ってことでいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: Aw, come on, she's going to share information with us. I think that's a fair trade.
records.en_auxiliary: Aw, come on, she's going to share information with us. I think that's a fair trade.
records.en: Come on, she is going to tell us all sorts of things.<CR>Let that be her payment, all right?

records.jp: 仕方ない！　許す！
records.en_original: Fine! I forgive you!
records.en_auxiliary: Fine! I forgive you!
records.en: Fine! I forgive you!

records.jp: 許すんですね……
records.en_original: I guess she wasn't quite as angry as she seemed...
records.en_auxiliary: I guess she wasn't quite as angry as she seemed...
records.en: You really are forgiving her...

records.jp: その代わり、<CR>これからはちゃんとあたしたちにも協力してよ？
records.en_original: But from now on you're going to help us, okay?
records.en_auxiliary: But from now on you're going to help us, okay?
records.en: In exchange,<CR>you have to cooperate with us from now on, okay?

records.jp: はい……
records.en_original: Understood...
records.en_auxiliary: Understood...
records.en: Understood...

records.jp: んんっ、じゃあ改めて――<CR>みんな、屋上に集まってほしい
records.en_original: Now that that's out of the way... Can we gather on the roof?
records.en_auxiliary: Now that that's out of the way... Can we gather on the roof?
records.en: Ahem. Let me begin again—<CR>Everyone, please gather on the roof.
